spotlight.title: IEEC International Electrical Engineering Conference
spotlight.text: The 12th IEEE International Electrical Engineering Conference (IEEE IEEC 2026) is a global forum dedicated to advancing research and innovation in electrical and electronic engineering. Jointly organized by NED University of Engineering & Technology, the Institution of Engineers Pakistan, and the University of Peradeniya, the hybrid event will take place on 17–18 October 2026 at the University of Peradeniya.
spotlight.venue: University of Peradeniya, Kandy, Sri Lanka

heroTitle: Sri Lanka’s first IEEE Student Branch.
heroText: Seven chapters and affinity groups, one community of young engineers — inspiring each other to achieve, and leading our community to greater heights through the worldwide IEEE network.
